finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If m_name contains a semicolon or other shell metacharacters, it could lead to command injection.
finding.assumptions: The code is running in an environment where the file name is interpreted by a shell, such as a script or a command line.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code constructs a file name in lines 10‑13 and then opens that file with std::ofstream::open on line 15. std::ofstream::open does not invoke a shell or any command interpreter; it simply creates or truncates a file with the given path. Therefore there is no path from the untrusted source (m_name) to a command execution sink, and the reported OS Command Injection cannot occur.
